newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Communications to offer fewer shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Communications to offer fewer shares in IPO.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc plans to offer 7.8 million shares at an estimated price range of $14 to $16 per share in its upcoming initial public offering, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Based on a midpoint price of $15 per share, the deal is thus valued at about $117 million.
The company previously planned to offer 12 million shares at the same price range of $14 to $16.
The offering, lead-managed by Merrill Lynch, is tentatively set for the week of September 23. The proposed stock symbol on the New York Stock Exchange is "SNC".
